title: dasycephala spicata
intro: Dasycephala spicata, commonly known as False Buttonbush, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dasycephala spicata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
